# Person B: measured numbers

Measured 31 Oct 2026 on a MacBook (Apple Silicon), Python 3.14, Tesseract 5.5.3.
**Test data is synthetic:** made-up PDFs generated by `tests/b_samples.py` (clean fonts, a clean "scan" rendered at 150 dpi). Real phone photos and old scans will score lower; we have not measured those yet.

Re-run: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -s tests/test_redact.py tests/test_ocr.py tests/test_compare.py tests/test_convert.py` (13 tests, all passing).

| Tool | What we measured | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Redact: detect | Planted NRIC/FIN, SG phone and email values found (`b_pii_letter.pdf`, 2 pages) | **10 / 10** |
| Redact: detect | Decoys wrongly flagged (an 8-digit invoice number, a postal code, an order ref, a date) | **0 / 4** |
| Redact: apply | Leak test: can any redacted value be copied out of the output? | **Pass** (none can) |
| Redact: apply | Time | 2.6 s for 2 pages |
| Redact: on a scan | Planted values caught on the scanned page (OCR runs first, automatically) | **5 / 5**, leak test pass, 1.6 s |
| Redact: audit | Text hidden under naive black boxes, found in `b_naive_redaction.pdf` | **3 / 3** recovered |
| OCR | Word accuracy on the scan sample vs the known text | **98.1%** |
| OCR | Time | ~2.0 s per page at 300 dpi |
| Compare | Planted edits found (2 changed words, 1 changed number, 1 removed clause, 1 added clause) | **5 / 5** text changes; 4 highlighted areas |
| Compare | Time | 0.2 s for one page |
| Convert | Table to Excel: cells match the source table | 1 table, all cells correct (test) |

## Failure cases we know about (show these, the rubric rewards it)
1. **OCR misreads a leading "S" as "$"** (`S1234567D` came out as `$1234567D`). Our NRIC pattern now also accepts `$`, so redaction still catches it, but the searchable text of an OCR'd page can contain the misread.
2. **Addresses and names are not detected** by the patterns. The Blk/street/postal address on the sample stays visible unless the user draws a box (or Person C's optional AI detection is switched on).
3. **Redacted pages become images plus an OCR text layer.** That is what makes removal guaranteed, but the page's original text quality on those pages is replaced by OCR quality.
4. Word export keeps text and images in page order, not the original layout.
